annotation_audit.chip_sample_contract: CH3 n; CH0 n+1; CH2 n+2; CH1 n+3
annotation_audit.doppler_contract: Unshifted cyclic bins 0..255; radar_D_mps is not converted to m/s
annotation_audit.label_policy: All supplied annotation qualities retained; invalid geometry excluded with reasons
annotation_audit.auxiliary_sensor_policy: All available recognized auxiliary sensors retained in native synchronization; absent CAN is not invented
annotation_audit.caveat: Metadata and byte availability do not prove physical annotation accuracy or ADC payload integrity

partition_audit.assignment_method: Frozen historical global recording roles; no subset rebalancing
partition_audit.historical_TEST_already_used_in_research: This assignment prevents further role drift; it does not erase earlier TEST exposure.

gamma_selection.rule: among gammas with robust CA-CFAR lost <= 1% and no robust label lost: highest FFTRadNet F1 (ties: smaller gamma); if none qualifies: fewest robust losses

fftradnet_finetune.free_space_target: official network on the ORIGINAL cube, sigmoid >= 0.5
fftradnet_finetune.detection_target: official ra_encoder of every evaluable label (easy and difficult)

predictions.P1: fixed_1p45 on TEST: robust CA-CFAR lost <= 1% and no robust label lost

frozen_model.source: V17 publication run v17_pub_20261030T001402535Z, selected epoch 15

configuration.test_policy: TEST unlocked once, after the entropy model, gamma and the fine-tuned networks are frozen
